about_the_game:
Atomica is an immersive 3D exploration game that shrinks you down to the nanoscale and places you directly on the surfaces of proteins. Walk across vast molecular landscapes, climb over ridges, descend into grooves, and discover ligands as if they were hidden landmarks in a strange new world. Atomica blends science and adventure, turning the invisible world of biology into a place you can truly explore.

Key Features

  • Explore proteins in 3D – Wander across realistic molecular surfaces built from actual scientific data.

  • Discover ligands – Find small molecules nestled in binding sites and learn their biological role.

  • Immersive scale – Experience what it feels like to stand on the nanoscale architecture of life.

  • Simple controls – Walk, look, and interact using only a game controller.

  • Relaxing gameplay – No combat, timers, or stress; just exploration and discovery.

  • Educational and fun – Perfect for players curious about science, students, or anyone who enjoys walking simulators with a twist.

Why Play Atomica?

If you’ve ever wondered what it would be like to step inside the microscopic world, Atomica lets you do just that. It’s a calm, surreal experience that blends gaming with science, offering a new perspective on the building blocks of life.
